referralCommission.subject: You earned {{amount}} with the Northstack referral program
referralCommission.body: {{companyName}} made payment {{paymentNumber}} of {{totalPayments}}, and you earned {{amount}}. It becomes payable on {{dueAt}}. We transfer once your payable balance reaches the minimum.

referralPayout.subject: We sent you {{amount}} for your referrals
referralPayout.body: On {{date}} we transferred {{amount}} to you for your referral commissions (transfer {{number}}).
referralPayout.receipt: The transfer receipt is attached. You can also download it from your referrals page.

invitation.subject: You're invited to join {{tenantName}} on Northstack
invitation.intro: You've been invited to join {{tenantName}} on Northstack as {{role}}.
invitation.contractNote: Your contract is attached to this email for your records.

timeOffPending.subject: Time off request awaiting your approval
timeOffPending.body: {{employeeName}} requested {{daysRequested}} day(s) of {{policyName}} ({{range}}) and it needs your approval.
timeOffPending.cta: Review it in Northstack under HR > Time Off.

timeOffDecided.subjectEmployeeApproved: Your time off request was approved
timeOffDecided.subjectEmployeeRejected: Your time off request was rejected
timeOffDecided.introEmployeeApproved: Your request for {{daysRequested}} day(s) of {{policyName}} ({{range}}) was approved{{autoSuffix}}.
timeOffDecided.introEmployeeRejected: Your request for {{daysRequested}} day(s) of {{policyName}} ({{range}}) was rejected{{autoSuffix}}.
timeOffDecided.introOtherApproved: {{employeeName}}'s request for {{daysRequested}} day(s) of {{policyName}} ({{range}}) was approved{{autoSuffix}}.
timeOffDecided.introOtherRejected: {{employeeName}}'s request for {{daysRequested}} day(s) of {{policyName}} ({{range}}) was rejected{{autoSuffix}}.
timeOffDecided.autoSuffix: automatically — this policy does not require approval

contractSigned.subject: Signed contract — {{employeeName}} ({{tenantName}})
contractSigned.body: {{employeeName}}'s contract with {{tenantName}} was just confirmed and signed.
contractSigned.attachmentNote: The signed contract is attached to this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your Northstack password
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset your Northstack password.
passwordReset.expiry: This link expires in 1 hour. If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

signupVerification.subject: Verify your email to finish setting up Northstack
signupVerification.body: Thanks for starting your Northstack signup — let's confirm this is your email.
signupVerification.expiry: This link expires in 24 hours. If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

opportunityStalled.subject: {{opportunityName}} has been stalled for {{daysInStage}} days
opportunityStalled.body: {{opportunityName}} ({{companyName}}) has been sitting in {{stageName}} for {{daysInStage}} days.

paymentMethodReminder.subject: Your last Northstack payment didn’t go through
paymentMethodReminder.body: We couldn’t charge the card on file for {{tenantName}}. To keep using Northstack without interruptions, please update your payment method.
paymentMethodReminder.footer: Once it’s updated, the payment is retried automatically. If you have any questions, just reply to this email.

supportAccess.subject: Northstack support is asking for access to your account
supportAccess.body: {{staffName}} from Northstack support would like to see your {{tenantName}} account to help you.
supportAccess.howTo: Open Northstack to accept or decline. Nothing happens unless you accept, and you can end the access at any time.
supportAccess.footer: If you weren’t expecting this, decline it and reply to this email.

accountDeletion.subject: Your {{tenantName}} account will be deleted
accountDeletion.body: The {{tenantName}} account on Northstack is scheduled for deletion. Nobody can sign in to it anymore, and all its data will be permanently deleted on {{date}}.
accountDeletion.undo: If this was a mistake, reply to this email before that date and we will restore it.
